## Instructions

1. Cream butter and sugar; add eggs one at a time.
2. Add mashed bananas.
3. Sift in the dry ingredients. [+]
4. Stir in nuts.
5. Bake in a greased loaf pan at 325°F, 45 minutes.

## Notes

"Always a hit."
